tonight.headline: Ahead after Thursday; Pickens questionable on the bench, nothing to set
body: Bad news first, and it stays on the bench: Garrett Wilson is OUT (concussion), and Dallas listed George Pickens QUESTIONABLE with the hamstring on Friday, Jake Ferguson too.

Bloodsports lead Jackrabbits 18.9 to 10.88; ESPN projects 127.1 to 108.5, a 61% chance. Every Sunday starter cleared Friday: Rice full Thursday and Friday, Taylor removed from the report, Jacobs and Golden not listed. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to do.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Jackrabbits still have Bijan Robinson and Ashton Jeanty, whose role Kubiak calls "a moving target" against Mike Washington Jr. (The Big Lead 4 Nov). They need about 117 more to your 108 projected.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Sunday starter is inactive at the 90-minute list and the bench is not used. None carries a designation after Friday.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: A free agent here, but Kubiak calls the split week to week.

case.label: The player
case.body: 25 carries for 83 in Week 8; Jeanty 2 carries plus 3-64 receiving. Kubiak: the split is "a moving target", week to week; Jeanty, Washington and Laube all contribute (The Big Lead 4 Nov). At San Francisco.

case.label: Why not
case.body: Bloodsports carry five backs; Marks has Houston's backfield with Montgomery out again.

case.label: When to act
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco and Montgomery back in Houston — then a free-agent add for Marks.

doNotChase.name: Brandon Aubrey
doNotChase.lead: Team 13 cut a 98%-owned kicker; he cleared waivers and is free — still not worth the move.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.5 against Gay's 9.3: 1.2 points, and Zvada (free agent, 10.4) gives the same edge. No injury — Team 13's cut was a fantasy move. Waivers cleared Sat 7 Nov 08:00Z, so he costs no priority now; the bar for a kicker swap is a real gap, not a point.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Gay injury — and even then Zvada is free.
